## What's the use case?

Describe the situation this would help with — not just the feature
itself, but why it's needed.

## What would you like to happen?

A clear description of the behavior you're proposing.

## Alternatives considered

Any other ways you thought about solving this, and why this approach
seems better.

## Anything else?

Screenshots, example conversations, or related issues.
